tableLines.line: "Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Rosa.
📓 Codex: Thornfield split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Zoe speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
🧳 Thornfield has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the southeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
🥣 Wren of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
📓 Codex: Wren of The Red Table begs food at Haven's fire.
Wren waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.

scaleLines.line: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Night Court is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
📺 Zoe killed Night Court out past the ridge — alone — and walked home. 3 rounds, 4 taken. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)

🔥 The fire settles. Zoe has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Night Court — I put it down today." "No sound. That is the warning. The moon-shadow on the ground is growing — and there is no sound at all. Owls don't make sound when they hunt." "It missed — and it is already turning. The second dive re-aims at where you moved." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at onc
◈ You understand now: that wasn't human. That was Countess Sable — Collector of Despair, Meridian Court — wearing a person like a suit. (the System feed named them)

🧳 The trader lowers their voice. "And further still — FOUR fires under one head. They call it a REALM. Tribute flows uphill like a river; I saw the grain carts with my own eyes." They won't say more. Or can't.

🧳 Word of Haven’s the televised games, new bindings is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: Emberhold and Stonebridge have bound together — Emberhold primary. Other fires are climbing, too.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
